title: Medical Data Rx
description: Technical Solutions Group, located in the heart of Mid-Michigan, is dedicated to assisting small businesses with their technology, advertising, and networking requirements. Their mission is to equip offices with top-quality computers, technology services, advertising solutions, and networking solutions to enhance workflow efficiency and cost-effectiveness. They offer PC and hardware sales, IT networking solutions, IT management and technical support, and server hosting services. With a focus on client satisfaction, they have a proven track record of delivering reliable support and solutions to businesses in need.
